name: WARNING: Knorr Chicken Flavor Bouillon Cubes (Dehydrated Onion & Hydrogenated Fat)
whyItWorks: A common hidden flare trigger in home cooking. Formulated with concentrated dehydrated onion powder, garlic powder, palm fat, and artificial colorings that trigger painful gas fermentation.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Always check soup and rice recipes. Swap Knorr cubes for boxed organic bone broth.
